en: See? It's just like I said.
Huh? What's just like you said?

Sometimes you gotta be a little reckless 
to make your dreams a reality!
Huh? What are you talking about?

Huh? What do you mean? It's thanks to me
we defeated Monokuma, right?

I still don't know how to get out of here... 
But the number one threat is gone now!

Ah, Kaito... To be honest,
what you did was really dangerous...
W-Well, I was a little nervous. Just a little.

But now we know the universe is watching!
That bear got the cosmic justice he deserved!

The universe is always on the side of those
who push the limits and never give up!
U-Um, I guess?

Anyway, Monokuma's gone now thanks to me!
All we gotta do is escape!

Monokuma's gone now thanks to me! 
All we gotta do is escape!
Hmm...

What's the matter, Gonta?
Searching for something?
There no bugs here after all...
Oh yeah, you did mention that before.
Gonta trying to understand why...

Ah, that's right. Of course the
Ultimate Entomologist would notice that.
Gonta have no idea, but...

Gonta not give up!
Gentleman not give up that easy!
So Gonta go search even more!

Who would've expected our foe to die in 
such a way... What a disappointing ending...

In any event, it means this situation is over...
I can go home and spend time with Sister.
Oh, you have a sister, Kiyo?
I bet she's worried about you.

<CLT=cltMIND>But that's probably true of everyone's family...
Including mine...

Sister is terribly lonely...
I need to get back to her as soon as possible...

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to get back to my parents and
friends, too!

Sister is terribly lonely...
I need to get back to her as soon as possible...

Are you going back to that underground
passageway?

Huh!? Why are you asking me that all of
a sudden?

You don't think this is over, do you?
Your attitude earlier gave it away.

And I figured you'd take on that passageway
with her since you two seem so chummy.
Ah, I-I'm not trying to take anyone's side...

You guys are free to do whatever you want,
just leave the rest of us out of it.

...She's kind of...unpleasant,
isn't she?

Hey, is the shuttle bus coming or not?
I've been waiting for a while now...

I don't think a bus is gonna come. This whole
place is surrounded by a caged wall.
Oh yeah...

Umm, it's just that...it's customary to 
come back from a con by bus.

I travel by bus even in summer and winter.
The bus driver sings sea shanties for me.

In the past, I was saddled with debt, but now 
I'm the proud owner of my very own home.
<CLT=cltMIND>What is she talking about?
Never mind...it's just plain unimportant...

Well, anyway... Since this wall's so big, I 
wonder how the bus would even get in here.
<CLT=cltMIND>Would a bus really be able to get here?

Since this wall's so big, I wonder how 
anyone would get in here to rescue us.

Hey, lookit you two!
Out for a walk together, huh!?

Why don'tcha pick up some rubbers over at
the warehouse!? Better safe than sorry!
Wha—!? W-We don't need those!

What? You must be a real fuckin' skank to
let dudes unload inside you!

By day you're fingerin' the piano keys, but at
night the dudes are fingerin' you, eh!?

Sh-Shut the hell up! What kind of girl do
you think I am!?
Heeeee!

I-It was a joke... I was just tryin' to lighten
the mood a little...

Let's ignore her, Kaede...
We have to focus.
<CLT=cltMIND>Right, we need to head to the library.

Hah-haha! A hat-wearin' perv and a fuckin'
skank! You two are so made for each other!
